shortDescription: Brocade Fibre Channel security ipfilter policy configuration

options.name: active_policy
options.description: Name of the active policy. Mutually exclusive with ipfilter_policies and delete_policy. This shoud come after policies are created and filled with rules

options.name: delete_policies
options.description: Name of the policy to be deleted. Mutually exclusive with ipfilter_policies and active_policy.

options.name: ipfilter_policies
options.description: List of ipfilter policies data structure. All writable attributes supported by BSN REST API with - replaced with _.

options.name: throttle
options.description: Throttling delay in seconds. Enables second retry on first failure.

options.name: timeout
options.description: REST timeout in seconds for operations that take longer than FOS default value.

options.name: vfid
options.description: VFID of the switch. Use -1 for FOS without VF enabled or AG.
